meta.description: Whaur newcomers mak new freends at furmeets an furry conventions. Bi Global Furry Television.
site.name: GFTV HelloSpot
official.line: An offeecial Global Furry Television wabsteid
official.domain-heading: Offeecial GFTV steids end wi globalfurry.tv or gftv.asia
official.domain-body: Read the address fae the end, at the hinmaist dot afore the first single slash. A steid that ends in onything else isnae GFTV, even gin the name kythes earlier in the address.
official.trusted-link: The hale leet o offeecial GFTV steids
official.secure-body: Leuk for a padlock, or https:// at the stairt o the address. Ainly share personal details on an offeecial steid ower a siccar connection.
update.label: Update
update.ready: A new version o GFTV HelloSpot is ready.
hero.card-alt: The HelloSpot name caird. It says Hello an 哈喽 aside a muckle smile, ower GFTV’s rainbae stripes.
hero.title: Ye fund a HelloSpot!
hero.lede: At furmeets an furry conventions, a HelloSpot is whaur newcomers mak new freends.
how.title: Hou a HelloSpot warks
how.spot.title: Spot the smile
how.spot.body: Leuk for the HelloSmile on a caird, a lanyard or a sign. Whauriver it is, that’s a HelloSpot.
how.hello.title: Say hullo
how.hello.body: Come ower an say hiya. Naebody at a HelloSpot expects ye tae ken onybody yet.
how.friend.title: Mak a freend
how.friend.body: Meet the fowk aroond ye, an leave wi somebody tae leuk oot for at the neist meet.

about.title: Global Furry Television
about.body-1: Global Furry Television (GFTV) is Asie’s biggest furry fandom news channel, based in Singapore.
about.body-2: We shaw aff furries’ growthe for awbody the day an the morn tae appreciate, an we host spaces sae fowk can learn aboot an unnerstaund ilk ither.
about.body-3: Raxin ower muckle continents fae hame, GFTV’s team is international, multicultural an multilingual.
